purpose: Select one conditional-context repair after V26 proved that its Haar interface discarded the child-phase information defining every target detail scale.

parent_failure.required_next: repair the condition-to-Haar interface without changing the density target, likelihood, optimizer, horizon, or gates

selected_change.name: parent_aligned_2x2x2_child_phase_condition
selected_change.old_at_detail_resolution_r: adaptive-average-pool each of four condition fields directly to r by r by r, yielding four local channels
selected_change.new_at_detail_resolution_r: adaptive-average-pool each condition field to 2r by 2r by 2r and apply exact 3-D space-to-depth with block size two, yielding 4x8=32 parent-aligned child-phase channels on the r grid
selected_change.information_property: the transform is bijective between the pooled 2r grid and the 32-channel r-grid representation, so all eight child values and every signed child contrast are retained
selected_change.coarsest_effect: the seven target octant contrasts at 1 cubed are conditioned on all eight observed octant values for every condition field rather than only whole-box averages
selected_change.finest_effect: the 32 cubed target details are conditioned on the exact eight 64-grid child voxels for every condition field
selected_change.additional_context_retained: the reconstructed coarser latent and eight train-only standardized observable scalar features

alternatives_rejected.name: per_scale_loss_reweighting_or_separate_optimizers
alternatives_rejected.reason: The stored Adam first/second moments show balanced effective update norms across scales and negligible decoupled weight decay despite raw dimension-weighted gradients.

alternatives_rejected.name: longer_training_or_another_capacity_only_retry
alternatives_rejected.reason: The first two validation-scale NLLs worsened from 10000 to 30000 in every domain while generated latent support excursions grew.

alternatives_rejected.name: pool_condition_to_r_then_use_larger_convolutions
alternatives_rejected.reason: No convolution can recover within-parent child phases after the r-grid average has discarded them, especially at the 1-grid coarsest scale.

alternatives_rejected.name: post_sample_clipping_rank_remapping_or_Ak
alternatives_rejected.reason: These operations would conceal likelihood miscalibration, break direct sampling semantics, and do not restore conditional morphology.

alternatives_rejected.name: change_G21_support_spline_bounds_or_flow_bins
alternatives_rejected.reason: The V26 failure was traced to condition aliasing rather than trained-spline numerical inversion or base-normal calibration.

alternatives_rejected.name: open_Astrid_or_historical_EAGLE
alternatives_rejected.reason: V26 failed the three-domain development gate and independent-data access remains forbidden.

invariants_from_v26: TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift train/validation files and the same fixed development objects
the frozen V21 exact-zero-DC conditional-affine Gaussianized latent and every inverse map
six-level orthonormal 3-D Haar target coordinates and train-only affine moments
four target-free condition fields and eight train-only observable scalar features
coarse-to-fine exact conditional rational-quadratic spline likelihood
six independent scale flows, four alternating channel couplings, eight bins, tail bound six, hidden width 32, and two residual blocks
equal-source batches, all 48 signed cube isometries, AdamW, learning-rate schedule, EMA, gradient clip, and mixed precision
sampling seeds, 16-member ensembles, physical inverse, field evaluator, Q3/Q4/Q5 thresholds, and smallest-passing-candidate rule

falsifiable_predictions.coarse_condition_sensitivity: coarsest context changes under a nontrivial cube isometry by the corresponding child-phase permutation rather than remaining invariant
falsifiable_predictions.base_z: truth base-z standard deviation at the first two scales moves toward one relative to V26 in every development domain
falsifiable_predictions.scale_nll: the first two fixed-validation scale NLLs no longer worsen jointly from 10000 to 30000 in all domains
falsifiable_predictions.latent_support: generated |G21 latent|>=5 occupancy and generated maxima decrease relative to V26 without clipping
falsifiable_predictions.field_outcome: Q3/Q4 and high-k/2PCF improve jointly if the missing phase interface was causal

hard_preflight_requirements: full pytest on the committed implementation
exact parent and audit hashes with a clean committed worktree
space-to-depth followed by depth-to-space exact roundtrip at all six resolutions
coarsest context cube-isometry sensitivity and correct child-phase permutation
condition channels are target-free and density truth never enters context
Haar roundtrip, Parseval identity, exact non-DC coverage, trained-flow forward/inverse checks, finite real-data gradients, and direct-sampling seed reproducibility inherited from V26
decision: freeze exactly one V27 context-interface change, implement from scratch-compatible initialization, and run one unchanged three-domain development program

firewall.independent_data_eligible_only_after: all-domain V27 development pass, committed seal, and explicit user approval
